title: Mario at EXIST 2025: A Simple Gateway to Effective Multilingual Sexism Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) on Llama 3.1 for a sexism detection classification task. While sexism is an ethical and social issue, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical doctrines themselves; it treats the task as a standard NLP classification challenge.
